searchText: you should know that some bobble heads are collectibles worth millions!! 😛 TIL that Solana has state rent https://docs.solana.com/developing/programming-model/accounts#rent NEAR has something similar as well (see https://github.com/near/NEPs/issues/40 for discussion and https://github.com/near/NEPs/tree/master/specs/Economics#state-stake for current model) Staking for storage is actually very economically misaligned Because it means that anyone with a lot of tokens can just come and grab a bunch of state for free And there is a lot of uncertainty over how much state gets used; in the worst case it could be a huge amount hmm I read both of those above docs just now I'm still convinced that the long-epoch expiry model (ie. what I proposed) is better than rent It "fails safely"
